FADE IN:

INT. VETERAN'S BEDROOM - DAY

We see a small, cluttered bedroom. There's a bed, a dresser, and a few pieces of furniture scattered around. The walls are adorned with old photographs and war memorabilia. We hear the sound of a clock ticking in the background.

We see a WW1 veteran, JIM (60s), lying in bed, looking confused. He's dressed in a worn-out uniform, and his hair is thinning. He's trying to remember something, but his eyes are cloudy.

JIM: (to himself) What was I doing? What was I doing?

He looks around the room, trying to remember. He sees a photograph on the dresser and points to it.

JIM: (excitedly) Ah, yes! The lads! We were at the front lines. I remember the sound of the guns, the smell of the mud...

He trails off, looking confused again.

JIM: (to himself) What was I saying?

Suddenly, he looks to his side and sees a man, TOM (30s), lying on the bed. Tom's eyes are closed, and his face is pale.

JIM: (alarmed) Oh no! Tom! Tom, wake up!

Tom doesn't respond. Jim tries to shake him, but Tom doesn't move.

JIM: (panicked) What's happening? What's happening to him?

Jim looks at Tom's head, and his eyes widen in horror.

JIM: (whispering) Oh God... his brains are falling out...

Jim's eyes are fixed on Tom's head, and he's trying to process what he's seeing. He looks like he's in a trance.

JIM: (whispering) I remember... I remember it all now...

Jim's eyes glaze over, and he starts to speak in a monotone voice.

JIM: (whispering) We were at the front lines... the guns were firing... the mud was everywhere... I saw a man get shot in the head... his brains fell out from the back of his head...

Jim's voice is distant, and he's not really remembering anything. He's just repeating what he thinks he saw.

JIM: (whispering) I was there... I was there...

The camera zooms out, and we see Jim's face, his eyes fixed on Tom's head. He's lost in a world of his own, reliving a moment that's not really his own.

FADE TO BLACK.
